_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 20 — arm 18 (canonical + LV-1 + LV-2) + CARD LV-4, the
FRAME-INVARIANT rx-CB carry screen (docs/SPEC_level_information_budget.md S11).
Single knob vs arm 18: network.rx_cb_carry_step_gate.
THE DEFECT BEING FIXED (measured, arms 12-19).  The carry's inject gate tests
|value_abs - x_lin(cb)| against 10 sigma + 0.5 m.  Both terms are absolute, but
x_lin is a FROZEN linearization point -- initializeCodeBiases seeds it once at the
first estimating epoch and the network solve is never written back -- so the
statistic is just the standing correction x_r: a property of where that seed
landed, not of anything the receiver did.  Two measured consequences:
(1) 48-67 % of ALL carry priors withheld for whole runs with no receiver event
(2) it is structurally BLIND to the jump it exists for: a receiver step between
epochs t-1 and t leaves the carried value pre-jump and x_lin unmoved, so the
statistic contains no information about the event at t's inject.
THE FIX.  The fold-time gate keeps only its frame-free checks (gap, variance
sanity).  The event response moves to the SERIAL post-solve harvest, the one place
where two ABSOLUTE realizations of the same receiver bias exist side by side -- the
fresh posterior (x_lin + x_r) and the carried value -- so their difference is
invariant under any reframing, reseeding or datum change:
z = |value_abs_new - value_abs_prev| / sqrt(var_new + var_prev + q*dt + 0.25)
z > 10 ERASES the entry (reset-not-repair: the post-jump posterior was solved in
the epoch that folded a stale pre-jump prior, so it is suspect too).  One epoch
cold, then the next harvest re-seeds from data.
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- Fold count RISES sharply -- the withheld population was frame, not physics.
Expect folds to approach the harvest count (arm 18: 381 folded / 777 withheld of
1158; predict > 900 folded here) and pl_cb_innov_skips to read 0 (the test that
produced them is off).
- The run-end LV-4 line reports the SAME-RUN A/B: `would have withheld N of those
folds`.  Predict N is large (order 700) and the invariant erase count is SMALL
(order 0-10 over 20 epochs at 61 quiet stations).  A large would-skip against a
near-zero erase count IS the finding: the old screen was measuring the seed.
- a00: MORE carry information folds, and arm 14 says carry stiffness holds the
level up while arms 15/17 say its common-mode content drags it down.  With LV-2
already draining the common mode, predict a00 lands at or above arm 18's
(trough 19.09, mean 25.80) -- i.e. the extra folds are DIFFERENCE information,
which is what the carry is for.  If a00 instead sags back toward arm 12, then
LV-2's de-mean is not fully draining the frame content of the newly admitted
rows and mu should be re-read against the larger folded set.
- Watch max z on the run-end line.  If it never approaches 10, the threshold is
inert on this lineage (k and the 0.5 m guard are INHERITED from the legacy gate
and NOT recalibrated for a step statistic -- detection floor ~5 m).  That is a
calibration item, not a defect, but it must be named rather than assumed.
